title: Hinomori Shiho — Unchanging Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, it's already this late...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did come home later than usual today after we had that party in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A part of me doesn't want everyone to hear Miku sing songs that I don't feel are 100% the right choices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I have so many precious memories involving her...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika's probably thinking about that offer right about now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't know what her answer is going to be, but I'll happily accept whatever she arrives upon since she's putting so much thought into it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A lot of what we talked about today was so nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I spent a ton of time practicing bass in my room even back then...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm not getting stuck as much while playing it now.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: If I'm really gonna be in a band with Ichika and the others, then that means my bass will mix with the sounds produced by a guitar, keyboard and drums.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: A band, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: It sounded like Ichika was pretty set on that. She even said she'd ask her dad to see if she can borrow his guitar.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Saki's learning how to play the piano from her mom, so she'll be on the keyboard...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Which just leaves Honami on the drums.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: I've seen a drum kit in the prep room for the music room before, so I'm pretty sure there's one somewhere at school... But can any of the teachers play them?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
What do we do if none of them can?
I guess we'd have to find some instructional videos online or something...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Also, we haven't actually decided to form a band yet.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: But if we really are going to start one.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: N-No, I shouldn't get my hopes up too much. Ichika's dad might say no, and we don't know what we're gonna do about the drums yet.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: And we'll need to practice in order to actually play like a real band.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: We could even be so bad that things end up not being fun...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (If the four of us do form one...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (It'll probably be... No, I know it'll be fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: I hope we hear good news about that guitar tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: And we should ask about that drum kit.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: I can't wait for it to be tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really haven't changed...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A lot of things happened, but I really wanted to be in a band with Ichika and the others.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't have any homework to do today, so I think I'll take a bath and go to bed early...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whatever Ichika has to tell us, we still need to practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I should rest while I can to make sure I do well tomorrow.
